free_tier.stated: The vendor withdrew the free cloud server on 2026-09-20. It was 1 core, 1 GiB RAM, 5 Mbps bandwidth and a 10 GiB data disk, with a dedicated public IP on BGP multi-line routing and a free 免备案 (no ICP filing) service. First activation ran 24 hours, an extension could be requested after 6 hours, and each approved extension added 5 to 10 days depending on real-name verification status; the vendor called the product permanently free. The notice states free instances were to be taken offline by 2026-09-27 and their disk data deleted. The paid cloud server starts at CNY 15 for the first month at 1 core, 1 GiB RAM, 5 Mbps and a 100 GiB data disk.
free_tier.notes: the free instance was time-boxed: 24 hours at first activation, then 5 to 10 days per approved extension, and deleted at expiry

per_object_cap.notes: the ceiling that mattered was the machine shape: 1 core, 1 GiB RAM and a 10 GiB data disk

retention.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not stored bytes; the instance and its disk are deleted when the free period ends
retention.notes: a machine record: what is lost is the running process and its disk

egress.terms: a 5 Mbps port on the free instance; the free product page states no monthly traffic allowance and no overage price

interface_detail: SSH on port 22 for the Linux images and RDP on 3389 for the Windows images, with a VNC console in the control panel; no API, CLI or SDK is documented on the vendor's help pages
tooling: no API, CLI or SDK is documented on the vendor's help pages; the control panel and SSH are the access paths
chaining: Not usable: the free tier stopped on 2026-09-20. The paid cloud server at CNY 15 for the first month needs the same real-name verification with a Chinese ID number, so it is not a substitute.

limits.value: 24 hours at first activation, then 5 to 10 days per approved extension; the instance and its disk are deleted when the free period ends
each extension requires a public post on a third-party site carrying the vendor's keywords and more than 20 characters of experience text, submitted for review
1 core, 1 GiB RAM, 10 GiB data disk and a 5 Mbps port

limits_note: one free instance per person, reported by a third-party walkthrough in 2026-05; the machine shape is 1 core, 1 GiB RAM and a 10 GiB data disk
binding_note: the instance is deleted 24 hours after activation unless a reviewed public post earns 5 to 10 more days, so holding the machine costs a recurring publishing task

identity_cost.detail: Registration takes an 11-digit mobile number and an SMS code: the register form's identity field is 手机号码 with maxlength 11, plus 手机验证码, and activation runs 注册登录, 关注微信公众号, 认证开通. Opening the free server needs 实名认证 (real-name verification): the vendor states domestic cloud resources require it, that the name and 身份证号码 (national ID number) must be correct, that the registered mobile number must belong to that person, and that a fee is charged on every attempt whether or not it succeeds. A third-party write-up puts the verification fee at CNY 0.3 and a CNY 1 minimum balance before activation.

reliability_note: the free instance and its disk are deleted when the free period ends and the vendor states the data cannot be recovered; the free cloud server stopped service on 2026-09-20, with instances offline by 2026-09-27
